task-intent.statement: Drive the bounded worktree-attribution correction through MCP, real red/green proof, independent review, and full Commander closeout.

expected-behavior.statement: The normal apply_patch tool would update tracked and work-area artifacts inside the repo-local writable worktree.

observed-behavior.statement: The normal patch helper failed with a bwrap loopback RTM_NEWADDR permission error even for writable worktree paths, while the escalated TTY apply_patch executable completed the same patches.

impact-cost.statement: Plan repair and implementation dispatch paused until the failure was reported and a supported patch route was confirmed.

workaround.statement: Use the approved escalated TTY apply_patch executable with patch text on stdin and EOF, and retain the incident in the work artifacts.

diagnosis.statement: The failure appears to be sandbox-helper network namespace setup rather than repository path permissions.
